stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import json
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    cols=sorted({x for r in g for x in r if x!=0})
    for i,col in enumerate(cols):
        oc=comps(g,col); isLeft=(i==0)
        # larger original top -> upper in stack
        order=sorted(oc, key=lambda o:min(p[0] for p in o))
        cur=h-1
        for o in order:
            hh=max(p[0] for p in o)-min(p[0] for p in o)+1
            lo=min(p[1] for p in o); hi=max(p[1] for p in o)
            span=hi-lo+1
            base = 0 if isLeft else w-span
            top=cur-hh+1
            for j,p in enumerate(sorted(o)):
                out[top+(p[0]-min(q[0] for q in o))][p[1]-lo+base]=col
            cur=top
    return out

def diag(g, mode='dl'):
    """simulate pieces sliding diagonally until blocked"""
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    objs=[(c,list(p)) for c,p in get_objs(g)]
    # each piece: list of (r,c); track separately
    pieces=[(c,[r-c2] for r,c2 in [])] if False else None
    pieces=[]
    for c,cells in get_objs(g):
        rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[cc for _,cc in cells]
        pieces.append({'c':c,'cells':[(r-rmin,cc-cmin) for r,cc in cells],
                       'top':min(rs),'left':min(cs)})
        pieces[-1]['abs']=[(r,min(rs),cc,min(cs)) for r,cc in cells]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    while True:
        moved=False
        # process in fixed order by original reading order
        order=[(i,p) for i,p in enumerate(pieces)]
        for idx,p in order:
            can=[False,False]  # down, left
            # down blocked if any cell below occupied or out
            cells=[(r+p['left'],cc) for r,cc in p['cells']]
            nb=[(r+1,cc) for r,cc in cells]
            db=all(0<=r<h and 0<=cc<w and out[r][cc]==0 for r,cc in nb)
            lb=all(0<=r<h and 0<=cc-1<w and out[r][cc-1]==0 for r,cc in cells)
            if mode=='d' and db: can[0]=True
            if mode=='l' and lb: can[1]=True
            if mode=='dl': can[0]=db; can[1]=lb
            if can[0] or can[1]:
                moved=True
                if can[0]:
                    for r,cc in cells: out[r+1][cc]=p['c']
                if can[1]:
                    for r,cc in cells: out[r][cc-1]=p['c']
                break  # one move per turn
        if not moved: break
    return out

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    groups={}
    for col,cs in get_objs(g): groups.setdefault(col,[]).append(cs)
    colorder=sorted(groups,key=lambda c:min(c for r,_ in [(r,c) for cs in groups[c] for r,c in cs]))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    cur_col=0
    for kcol in colorder:
        pcs=sorted(groups[kcol],key=len,reverse=True)
        def ww(p): return max(r for r,_ in p)-min(r for r,_ in p)+1  # placeholder
        maxc=max(c for p in groups[kcol] for r,c in p); wband=maxc-min(c for p in groups[kcol] for r,c in p)+1
        left=max(0,cur_col+wband-(w-maxc)) if False else max(0, cur_col+sum(max(c for p in gkp for r,c in p)-min(c for p in gkp for r,c in p)+1 for gkp in list(groups.values())[:colorder.index(kcol)]) )
        # simpler: compute per-color left offset such that band is flush right
        left=w-1-maxc
        cur=h-1
        for p in reversed(pcs):

            t=cur-hh+1
            for rr,cc in p: out[t+rr-m][cc+left]=kcol
            cur-=hh+1
        cur_col+=left+wband+1
    return out

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    groups={}
    for col,cs in get_objs(g): groups.setdefault(col,[]).append(cs)
    bands=[]
    for col,pcs in groups.items():
        minc=min(min(c for r,_ in p) for p in pcs)
        bands.append((minc,col,pcs))
    bands.sort()
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    prev_end=-1
    for i,(minc,col,pcs) in enumerate(bands):
        bw=max(max(c for r,_ in p) for p in pcs)-minc+1
        start=prev_end+2 if i>0 else 0
        # if start+bw>w, flush right
        if start+bw>w: start=w-bw
        cur=h-1
        for p in sorted(pcs,key=len,reverse=True):
            m=min(r for r,_ in p); M=max(r for r,_ in p); hh=M-m+1
            t=cur-hh+1
            for rr,cc in p: out[t+rr-m][cc-start]=col
            cur-=hh+1
        prev_end=start+bw-1
    return out

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    groups={}
    for col,cs in get_objs(g): groups.setdefault(col,[]).append(cs)
    bands=[]
    for col,pcs in groups.items():
        # bottom piece of the stack: the one with largest min col (in original input)
        def mcol(p): return min(c for r,c in p)
        bp=max(pcs,key=mcol)
        mc=mcol(bp)
        bands.append((mc,col,sorted(pcs,key=lambda p:mcol(p),reverse=True)))
    bands.sort()
    res=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    starts=[]
    # first band flush left, rest flush right
    prev_end=None
    for i,(_,col,pcs) in enumerate(bands):
        bw=max(max(c for r,c in p) for p in pcs)-min(mcol(p) for p in pcs)+1
        if i==0: s=0
        else: s=w-bw
        cur=h-1
        for p in pcs:
            t=cur-(cur-m)+0  # recompute properly below
            m=min(r for r,c in p); M=max(r for r,c in p); hh=M-m+1
            t=cur-hh+1
            for rr,cc in p: res[t+rr-m][cc-s]=col
            cur-=hh+1
        prev_end=s+bw-1
    return res

    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    groups={}
    for col,cs in get_objs(g): groups.setdefault(col,[]).append(cs)

    bands.sort()
    res=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    prev=0

        cur=h-1

            for rr,cc in p: res[t+rr-m][cc-s]=col
